Earlier gameplay summary (agent-written, uncertain claims remain uncertain):
CURRENT — Lake 04, PILLAR YARD, unfinished. Overworld 00–07 previously completed (counter 8); Lake 01–03 completed, latest lake counter 3/8. Screenshots are omitted: visual evidence below comes from earlier observation reports, not fresh inspection.

LATEST STATE / ACTIVE INVESTIGATION
- Lake 4 observed rules: BABA IS YOU, PILLAR IS PUSH, WALL IS STOP, FLAG IS WIN, STAR IS DEFEAT. Stars surround the physical flag; STAR IS DEFEAT is at the bottom-right boundary. No complete board inventory or solution established.
- BABA started in a small walled chamber. An outlined tile led right to a pillar blocking the opening. Rightward pushes moved the pillar out along the corridor/brick-patterned ground toward the star enclosure; BABA followed.
- Tested pushing the pillar into the nearest star: pillar and star overlapped and both remained visible; BABA stayed immediately left. This did NOT remove the star or establish safe passage for BABA. Direct BABA contact with stars has not been tested here.
- BABA then moved Down three times along the enclosure's left exterior to a clear row one tile below its bottom stars, initially one column left of the bottom-left star. Subsequent rightward movement beneath the enclosure was observed.
- Last observation: BABA one row below the bottom stars, with the tile immediately right empty; STAR IS DEFEAT visible at bottom-right edge. Latest input was Right for 0.1 seconds, execution completed, with NO subsequent screenshot. A further one-tile rightward move is expected, not confirmed.
- Active investigation was exploring the clear exterior beneath the enclosure toward the lower-right rule area while preserving control. No rule word has been moved in Lake 4. Accessibility/manipulability of STAR IS DEFEAT, other ways around the stars, and a solution remain unresolved. No completion evidence.

CONTROLS / EXECUTION
- 0.1-second arrow inputs repeatedly moved one tile or pushed objects/word chains. On maps arrows move one connected path step; Return enters the selected level/area.
- Lowercase z is confirmed undo: in 07 it reversed movement and one-/two-word pushes; in Lake 2 it reversed a CRAB push and restored the previous gap. Uppercase Z was not the tested input.
- Legend labeled Space as WAIT, but lowercase space input was rejected; waiting remains untested. No restart or area-exit control learned.
- stale_observation rejections did NOT execute. Celebrations repeatedly transitioned to maps despite rejected Return. Accepted Return during entry/title transitions does not prove it caused progression rather than automatic timing.

MAP RELATIONSHIPS
- Overworld 05 VOLCANO is immediately left of 07 GRASS YARD. From 07, four Right path steps reached an upward bend; the first step is a junction immediately right of 07 and above 06. Two Up steps reached blue node '1. THE LAKE'; Return entered its map.
- Lake entrance marker is at the bottom of a vertical white path; three Up steps reached 01 ICY WATERS. 02 TURNS is directly above 01. 03 AFFECTION is immediately left of 02; 04 PILLAR YARD is directly above 02. Travel 03→02→04 was observed. Other lake nodes/exit routes remain unexplored in this history.

LAKE 1 — ICY WATERS, COMPLETED
- Initial rules included BABA IS YOU AND SINK, JELLY IS SINK, WALL IS STOP, FLAG IS WIN. BABA left its chamber through the bottom opening.
- Approached exposed SINK from above and pushed it down once: AND dimmed, BABA IS YOU stayed bright, and control persisted. Initial precaution about BABA overlapping objects while possessing SINK was never tested directly.
- Blue patterned terrain allowed BABA to move right/up without disappearing; the loose WALL word could also be pushed across it.
- Loose WALL began in a central-right clearing. Pushed it right along the row below the jelly ring until aligned with the flag and directly below the bottom-center jelly; circled underneath and pushed upward. WALL and that jelly disappeared, BABA survived, and the resulting gap was traversable.
- BABA passed through the gap and touched the flag; celebration and subsequent lake counter 1/8 confirmed completion. Rejected Return did not cause the map transition.

LAKE 2 — TURNS, COMPLETED
- Initial rules: BABA IS YOU, ROCK IS PUSH, WALL IS STOP, STAR IS SINK, SKULL IS DEFEAT, FLAG IS WIN. Outlined floor tiles proved traversable. Starting right chamber connected left through a rock-blocked opening to the main room; two rocks were available. A narrow left passage contained a star and skull and led to a small chamber with loose CRAB above vertical BABA IS YOU. A physical crab and flag were outside.
- Moved loose AND right once/up twice beside PUSH. Lifted SINK out of STAR IS SINK, leaving dim STAR IS; routed SINK right twice/down three times to form ROCK IS PUSH AND SINK. Safely pushing such rocks over empty floor was confirmed.
- Lifted the right-hand rock onto the passage row and pushed left into the star: rock and star disappeared, BABA survived. Moved the second rock left once to clear rule words, up three times onto the passage row, then left into the skull: both disappeared, BABA survived. During circling, shifted the incomplete STAR IS fragment right together; active rock rule stayed intact.
- Initially pushed CRAB down twice toward BABA IS YOU, then undid the second push to restore a gap. No control loss occurred; direct replacement was not tested. Parked CRAB above the passage instead.
- With both rocks consumed, lifted AND out of the rock rule onto the passage row, pushed loose SINK right to make room, and transported AND left beneath CRAB. ROCK IS PUSH remained intact. Two downward chain pushes of CRAB+AND completed vertical CRAB AND BABA IS YOU.
- Both physical BABA and crab responded to the same Right input, confirming shared control of nouns joined by AND. Subsequent Down inputs moved the crab toward the flag; when a wall blocked BABA, the crab continued independently. Crab touched flag; celebration and map counter 2/8 confirmed completion.

LAKE 3 — AFFECTION, COMPLETED
- Initial rules: BABA IS YOU (lower-right), LOVE IS PUSH, LOVE IS WIN, KEKE IS MOVE, ALGAE IS DEFEAT. A heart was enclosed by algae
